title: Framework automatic ModSecurity v3 updater can plan an incomplete provenance identity change
title_de: Framework-Autoupdater für ModSecurity v3 kann eine unvollständige Provenance-Identitätsänderung planen
observed_behavior: After the parser repair makes ModSecurity v3 approved literals visible, a live check reports v3.0.15 outdated and plans to change only MODSECURITY_V3_GIT_REF at line 184 to v3.0.16. The scheduled privileged workflow writes common.sh and creates a pull request, but it cannot simultaneously establish the reviewed release-tag-to-immutable-commit identity.
expected_behavior: The automated updater must not write a partial ModSecurity v3 identity. A new release must remain an explicit review item unless the updater can atomically verify and update the release tag, repository identity, and approved immutable commit.
impact: Runtime provenance validation rejects the inconsistent alias fail-closed, so this is not a confirmed supply-chain bypass. However, the privileged scheduled workflow could create unusable update pull requests and pressure an operator to weaken a provenance control. Preventing partial automation preserves the approved tag-to-commit boundary.
preconditions: GitHub reports a ModSecurity v3 release newer than MODSECURITY_V3_RELEASE_TAG.
The scheduled workflow runs --update with contents and pull-requests write permissions.
reproduction: Run python3 ci/tools/check-common-versions.py --check --json --timeout 20 after the parser resolves the approved literals.
Observe an outdated ModSecurity v3 component and an update plan for only MODSECURITY_V3_GIT_REF.
Inspect the scheduled workflow write mode and ci_require_approved_modsecurity_v3_provenance invariant.
Confirm the plan does not update MODSECURITY_V3_RELEASE_TAG or MODSECURITY_V3_APPROVED_COMMIT atomically.

evidence.command: python3 ci/tools/check-common-versions.py --check --json --timeout 20; source and scheduled-workflow review
evidence.summary: The exact update plan changes only MODSECURITY_V3_GIT_REF from its release-tag alias to v3.0.16 while the approved tag and immutable commit remain unchanged.
On exact Framework master 784977615acfc55567e37b863309abc4a38ac877, the newer ModSecurity v3 release is visible as unknown/manual review with an empty update list and no partial alias update.

root_cause: check_all invokes the generic check_github_release_ref with the compatibility alias MODSECURITY_V3_GIT_REF as ref_var. The generic updater has no mechanism to authenticate a release tag to its immutable commit or to update the coupled approved identity atomically.
proposed_remediation: Model ModSecurity v3 after the existing CRS provenance path: check the approved repository/release tag, report a newer release as unknown/manual review, and clear automated updates. Add a focused regression proving that an outdated ModSecurity v3 release produces no applied update and cannot change the compatibility alias alone.
acceptance_criteria: An outdated ModSecurity v3 release produces no automatic update for MODSECURITY_V3_GIT_REF.
The component reports a review-required unknown/manual-review state rather than a partial update.
The candidate component result yields exit code zero when only review-required unknown states remain.
The existing runtime exact-commit and alias-equality provenance checks remain unchanged.
No Parent, Sonar control, or MRTS file changes.
validation_plan: Add focused in-memory release-client coverage for the outdated ModSecurity v3 path.
Run the focused common-version provenance suite and ModSecurity v3 provenance contract.
Review the candidate's empty update list and exact diff; never run update mode against canonical common.sh.
legitimate_control_tests: The current approved ModSecurity v3 release remains current with no update.
A newer release remains visible for manual review without changing common.sh.
Runtime provenance still rejects mismatched aliases or immutable commits.
dependencies: GitHub Releases API availability for the check
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-FRAMEWORK-0027. FND-FRAMEWORK-0027 owns missing parser resolution of approved literals. This finding owns the separately remediable partial automatic-update behavior that becomes reachable once those literals resolve.
evidence_limitations: The retained proof is a live check-mode update plan plus static workflow/control review; update mode was not run against canonical common.sh to avoid source mutation.

The candidate uses an empty update list and independent source-security review confirmed that the scheduled update applicator has no ModSecurity v3 write to perform; the historical exact-head PR evidence remains retained separately from the resulting-master verification.
The runtime control currently rejects the inconsistent outcome, so no successful malicious or compromised dependency update was reproduced.
The current user boundedly accepted the unrelated FND-SONAR-0002 master-only gate only for protected PR #36 delivery; it did not waive this finding's PR controls or establish any general acceptance.
No Parent gitlink or MRTS action occurred.
residual_risk: Manual ModSecurity v3 release maintenance remains necessary until a safe tag-to-immutable-commit resolver is designed and reviewed. This repair intentionally preserves manual review rather than synthesizing a commit pin from an unverified release tag.

delivery_evidence.limitations: The exact resulting master was verified with the original non-writing check-mode reproducer. The separate FND-SONAR-0002 master-only Security E remains globally blocked and is not treated as a source-fix failure for this finding.

history.detail: The live check planned only MODSECURITY_V3_GIT_REF=v3.0.16. Security review confirmed the runtime contract remains fail-closed but the scheduled privileged updater could otherwise create an inconsistent pull request.

The provenance wrapper returns a manual-review result with an empty update list for a newer ModSecurity v3 release. Focused, provenance-contract, documentation, lint, and independent security review controls passed; exact-head Framework Draft PR evidence remains pending and no Framework master, Parent, or MRTS Git action occurred.

Framework Draft PR #36 exact head 2bf862e1a5f262251043ec421447f6e4db11e17d against master efdbcbd98afeed0f39f8912ce1140aaa5742f507 is CLEAN with 11 successful and 3 expected-skipped terminal checks, no failed/cancelled/pending check, and no review or unresolved review thread. Framework master merge and current-master reproduction remain unauthorized and pending; FND-SONAR-0002 stays separate and blocked.

PR #36 refreshed exact head 1608352912a755f0f8639eddfa2350436446067e was normally merged as Framework master 784977615acfc55567e37b863309abc4a38ac877; the head is an ancestor with an identical tree. Fresh PR-head controls passed before merge. The original check-mode reproducer reran on exact master with exit 0 and reports the newer ModSecurity v3 release as unknown/manual review with an empty update list, preventing a partial alias update. Parent and MRTS remained unchanged. Separate FND-SONAR-0002 stayed globally blocked, but its bounded master-only acceptance was used only for this protected delivery.
